conditions.C: Same recipe plus explicit conditional execution-first routing paragraph

decision_rule.correctness: Every C run must pass both artifact and semantic grading; no lower pass count on any task than A or B. All valid failed runs and recovery costs remain in resource totals.
decision_rule.covered_task: For Task 9 the SAME branch must succeed against both A and B: either >=1 fewer median agent calls with median uncached input <=105% of comparator, with >=3/4 paired call wins against each; OR median uncached input <=90% with calls no higher, with >=3/4 paired uncached-input wins against each.
decision_rule.mechanism: Task 9: >=3/4 C runs skip BOTH configure guide and config schema, versus <=1/4 B runs. Retrieval is a process measure, never an oracle for correctness.
decision_rule.guards: For tasks 8 and 1, C median agent calls no higher and median uncached input <=105% of A. Task 8 reference reading is appropriate; correct results, not retrieval compliance, determine success.
decision_rule.secondary: Report cached input, output including reasoning, shell and CLI calls, guide/schema retrievals, and final-delivery duration. On any task a C median >120% of either A or B for any secondary metric prevents unqualified adoption; retain the primary and mechanism conclusions separately.
decision_rule.interpretation: Diagnostic practical gates, not statistical significance. C-B isolates the complete routing paragraph, not individual sentences or causal mediation; C-A measures the complete proposed help against current product. No automatic product installation.

integrity: Freeze wording, task definitions, schedule, runner, grader and binary hashes before launching. Sequential arms within triads; at most three fresh explorers concurrently. Preserve prior samples separately. Model/effort/context and final counters audited.
review: Independent final-answer review with condition/resource labels hidden. Answers can reveal their route, so blinding is imperfect.
preflight: Independent MEDIUM preflight added baseline measurement before edits, explicit intentional Other routing, same efficiency branch across comparators, exact schedule, and a numeric secondary-cost threshold.
